posts.title: <Resistance>

posts.html: Resistance. Groups of people tormented by the legion have formed in the darkened streets of City 18, those of us who cannot afford their "Citizenship" or simply choose to live free of their crushing tyranny are coming together in an alliance to break the waves of Legion and bring free rights to City 18, anyone who wishes to join this rebellion should contact me in the field (( In game or PM me on the forums )) for application, their over ruling of the city has gone on too long. --Austen Thompson.
